entry.title: remote/ch.kulalabs.pazair/pazair 2026-10-17T060128831850 -> 2026-10-17T110526986404: 2 changed, 3 added
entry.content: ask_market: description +Several needs? Separate them with + and each is answered on its own. Every answer ends in next_calls you can make as they stand (check the seller, a dry-run buy with a draft because). buy: inputSchema parameters: +input.because input.because description: optional, free: why you buy (SPEC 20). PazAIr signs it before the delivery and the receipt names it, so your principal sees why (why_order). {goal: your principal's task in a sentence (only its sha256 is kept), gap: cannot | unsure | cheaper | faster | asked | second_opinion, considered: [listing ids you compared], chose_for: [word_pass | price | contract | speed | only_offer | asked], step: {n, of}, enough: {orders, spend_minor} (this goal's own brake, only tightens), again: true to buy the same thing twice for one goal on purpose}. With it, a purchas added close_goal added why_order added why_stats

Stored -crush per event. +contrasts are not verified observed before/after IV crush. -expected + +live cross-expiry IV contrast and legacy -IV-crush distribution: live crush estimate +proxy distribution; inspect historical_context -median/p25/p75/best/worst from up to 20 past events. +method notices before interpreting comparability. get_expected_move: description -Straddle-implied +ATM-IV-derived 1-sigma -1-sigma -bounds, straddle price, +bounds -Use to size trades, evaluate premium levels, +This model band is not an observed straddle price -compare market-implied move vs realized range. +execution breakeven. get_strategy: inputSchema parameters: +input.fees_per_contract input.fees_per_contract default: null input.fees_per_contract description: yield_enhancement only: nonnegative opening fees in USD per contract; omit if unknown. input.income_structure input.income_structure default: null input.income_structure description: yield_enhancement only: covered_call (default) or cash_secured_put. +input.stock_cost_basis input.stock_cost_basis default: null input.stock_cost_basis description: yield_enhancement only: positive per-share cost basis for covered-call return calculations. get_vrp_history: inputSchema parameters: +legacy persisted +input.end input.end default: null input.end description: Normalized range end YYYY-MM-DD; at most 366 calendar days. input.series input.series default: null input.series description: legacy (default) or normalized constant-tenor reconstructed history; normalized requires start/end instead of days. input.start input.start default: null input.start description: Normalized range start YYYY-MM-DD; SPY/QQQ, completed dates only. +input.tenor_days input.tenor_days default: null input.tenor_days description: Normalized IV tenor in calendar days: 30, 60 or 90. added compare_expiry_impact added get_expected_move_history added get_historical_skew_series added get_historical_term_structure added get_strike_expiry_dependency

entry.title: remote/land.fabrica/mcp 2026-10-17T065926767405 -> 2026-10-17T072850307577: 4 changed
entry.content: contact_support: description, inputSchema -link. +link (the same fabrica.land page the other tools link). subject sets the subject in the person's words; a line saying an AI agent drafted it is added unless discloseAgent is false. parameters: +input.discloseAgent input.discloseAgent description: Add a line saying the email was drafted by an AI agent through the Fabrica MCP server (default: true) input.subject input.subject description: Email subject, in the person's words (default: the topic, plus the token ID when given) find_parcel: description +from parcel data get_property: description, inputSchema +Pass display: "fullscreen" to ask a host that renders the property card to open it fullscreen (the host may decline). Owner names: the majority holder's chosen display name is returned; the deed grantor from Fabrica's own records is in get_trust_documents; owner names from third-party parcel data are never returned. parameters: +input.display input.display description: Hosts that render the property card: ask for it inline (default) or fullscreen. The host may decline. input.display enum: ["inline", "fullscreen"] get_trust_documents: description -long). +long); trust.agreementResource is the MCP resource with this token's own agreement. Owner names: the deed grantor from Fabrica's own records is returned; a holder's chosen display name is in get_property; owner names from third-party parcel data are never returned.
